name: application-fuel-charge-gauge
title: Fuel / Charge Gauge
description: Vertical tank/battery-style level indicator with a percent readout and estimated range in miles — distinct from gauge-chart, which is a semicircular arc-and-needle dial rather than a fill-level capsule.
useWhen: Showing a vehicle's fuel or battery level alongside an estimated driving range.
A compact capsule-style fill indicator fits better than a full arc dial.
Low-level state should trigger both a color change and explicit warning text.
avoidWhen: You need a general-purpose semicircular dial with a needle — use gauge-chart instead.
There's no range estimate to pair with the level — a plain progress bar is simpler.
You need multiple simultaneous gauges in a dashboard grid — consider a more compact stat-tile.
responsiveBehavior: The capsule has a fixed height and scales its fill height proportionally; the card itself is fluid up to a max width.
accessibility: The capsule carries role='img' with an aria-label stating the exact percent, range, and low-level status, since fill height alone isn't announced by screen readers.
Low level is conveyed by both a red fill color and explicit 'Low — refuel soon' text, not color alone.
Percent and range are always shown as text next to the capsule, never only as a visual fill.

variants.title: Fuel / charge gauge
variants.description: A 68% fuel level with a computed 312-mile range estimate, on a light surface.
accessibility: Fill height is the real levelPercent value, not a hand-styled approximation.

variants.title: Fuel / charge gauge (Dark)
variants.description: The same fuel gauge, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Fill and text colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
